verdict.rationale: Motion supports recurring tasks (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly) that auto-schedule onto the calendar, and offers an API for creating/updating tasks and projects, which together provide some recurring-job automation for AI-native users. However, there's no evidence of an AI-native workflow/job scheduler with cron-like triggers, no documented API endpoint for defining recurring API-driven jobs, and no mention of programmatic/agent-triggered recurring workflows beyond the consumer UI feature. missing for 10: API support for creating/managing recurring tasks programmatically, documented workflow automation triggers for AI agents, and independent verification of recurring-task reliability.
